proposal: Use the same current official receiver/document and existing browser continuation scaffold. Each supported format boundary receives a fresh native arm nonce and separate archive job; full init validation remains mandatory.

Serialize finish/arm/cancel transitions under the existing arm gate. Bind continuation to owner(run,generation,canonical channel,video), document epoch and active recording intent. Stop/off/shutdown/account/page changes revoke pending authority before touching current media.

Limit continuation to3 attempts per60sec and at most2 consecutive no-progress boundaries per run. Preserve failed zero-progress artifacts/chat, expose terminal error when limits/expiry fail, never retry disk/parser/transport/ad/auth failures.

YouTube-local scheduler observation returns latest exact-owner capture plus pending flag; CAS update the tracked job so finalizer polling and off follow later segments. Keep bounded post-dispose owner/result mapping; missing proof becomes error, not old-job completion. Shared ScheduledState and SOOP behavior unchanged.

Root supplies a narrow YouTube format-boundary finalizer that flushes only validated complete segments, publishes only through existing final-media verification, and preserves failed/incomplete material. It returns actual segment progress; finalizing is not success.

When one accepted append contains old media before changed init, queue only the already-observed old prefix before raising failure, then stop forwarding. Never enqueue new-format bytes into old archive.

Separate race defense: automatic arm and browser start recheck automatic stability; pending continuation waits on the same video/source until bounded stability succeeds. Manual initial readiness remains unchanged; user quality and official playback are not overridden.
